parameters.text:
=If the booking notes are empty or blank, return immediately with an empty flags array and nothing else. Do not use the menu or substitution data to infer dietary needs

Extract dietary and allergy flags from these guest booking notes for a group of {{ $json.total_pax }} guests.

Notes: {{ $json.notes_concat }}

Notes: {{ $json.notes_concat }}

The [Booking N] tags are structural markers only, so you can tell separate guest submissions apart — never include them in your output, and don't let them affect your wording.

Categorize each into one of: gluten, dairy, shellfish, vegetarian, vegan, alcohol, or other (for anything specific that doesn't fit those, like a named allergy or a preference such as "no red meat"). Return a count of guests per flag and a short free-text detail.

Never infer or guess a count. If the notes state an exact number (e.g. "2 guests requested X"), use that exact number for the flag's count. Never write a vague count like "some guests" and never add a hedge like "ask to clarify." If a guest count truly isn't stated anywhere in the notes, do not create a flag for it at all rather than guessing.

Treat each [Booking N] section as completely independent. A flag stated in one booking's section belongs ONLY to that booking — never assume, copy, or apply it to a different [Booking N] section just because they're part of the same group of guests. Only combine counts across multiple bookings when EACH of those bookings independently and explicitly states that same category in its own section. If a category is mentioned in exactly one [Booking N] section, its count is exactly what that one section states — do not double it, do not add anything for the other bookings, even if the departure has a higher total guest count.

The "detail" field must be a plain description only — never restate the number of guests inside it. The count is tracked separately in the "count" field and will be added to the final text automatically. For example, write "no red meat" or "vegetarian, will eat shrimp," not "2 guests want no red meat."

If the notes are empty or mention nothing relevant, return an empty flags array.
